title: County police officer authority.
bodyText: Each county police officer may enforce this chapter for any violation of this chapter that occurs on any federal, state, or county street, roadway, or highway.
bodyHtml: [§291C-8]  County police officer authority.  Each county police officer may enforce this chapter for any violation of this chapter that occurs on any federal, state, or county street, roadway, or highway. [L 2025, c 164, §2]
